amourAmiH.q1: Honestly, have you ever imagined making love with him?
amourAmiH.q1a: No, never, the idea makes me uncomfortable
amourAmiH.q1b: Once, and I quickly thought about something else
amourAmiH.q1d: Yes, and it keeps coming back
amourAmiH.q2: Could you see yourself living with him, as a couple, not as roommates?
amourAmiH.q2a: No, we'd drive each other crazy
amourAmiH.q2b: I've never thought about it that way
amourAmiH.q2c: Yes, it doesn't seem that strange to me
amourAmiH.q2d: Yes, and I've already pictured it in detail
amourAmiH.q3: If he kissed you tonight, out of the blue…
amourAmiH.q3a: I'd pull back, or burst out laughing
amourAmiH.q3b: I'd be embarrassed, not knowing what to make of it
amourAmiH.q3d: I've been waiting for that moment for a long time
amourAmiH.q4: When he tells you about someone he likes…
amourAmiH.q4a: I'm happy for him, I want to know everything
amourAmiH.q4b: It doesn't do anything special to me
amourAmiH.q4c: It stings, but I act as if nothing's wrong
amourAmiH.q4d: I change the subject, it makes me sick
amourAmiH.q5: The idea of him getting into a serious relationship…
amourAmiH.q5a: Makes me happy, it's what I wish for him
amourAmiH.q5b: Scares me a little about losing him, like with any friend
amourAmiH.q6: Physical contact with him (a hug, his hand, his head on your shoulder)…
amourAmiH.q6a: It's like with my other friends, nothing more
amourAmiH.q6b: It's nice, with no ulterior motive
amourAmiH.q6c: I look for it a bit, and it always lasts a little too long
amourAmiH.q6d: It does something to me, and I know it
amourAmiH.q7: The people you're attracted to, do you compare them to him?
amourAmiH.q7a: Never, it has nothing to do with it
amourAmiH.q8: When you say "he's my best friend" to introduce him…
amourAmiH.q8a: That's exactly it, the word fits
amourAmiH.q8b: Sometimes the word feels a bit short
amourAmiH.q8c: It stings a little every time
amourAmiH.q9: When you're on a date with someone else…
amourAmiH.q9a: I don't think about him, or only to tell him about it afterwards
amourAmiH.q9b: I sometimes wonder what he would think
amourAmiH.q9c: I think about him more than about the person in front of me
amourAmiH.q9d: I'd rather it were him sitting there
amourAmiH.q10: The "what if…?", have you ever asked yourself while looking at him?
amourAmiH.q10c: Yes, and I think about it again
amourAmiH.q11: Have people ever told you that you'd make a good couple?
amourAmiH.q11a: No, or it just made us both laugh
amourAmiH.q11c: Yes, and it pleased me without my showing it
amourAmiH.q11d: Yes, and I thought about it again that night
amourAmiH.q12: Good news comes in. Who do you text first?
amourAmiH.q12d: Him, and I wait impatiently for the reply
amourAmiH.q13: Before seeing him, do you pay attention to how you look?
amourAmiH.q13a: No, he has seen me in every state
amourAmiH.q13b: A little, like for going out
amourAmiH.q13c: More than with my other friends
amourAmiH.q13d: Yes, and I wonder what he will think
amourAmiH.q14: Has he already met your parents?
amourAmiH.q14c: Yes, and they tease me about it
amourAmiH.q14d: Yes, and I really wanted them to like him
amourAmiH.q15: When he doesn't reply for a whole day…
amourAmiH.q15c: I check my phone more often
amourAmiH.q15d: It nags at me, I wonder what I did
amourAmiH.modesDesc: The questions adapt to the person. Just tell us who we're talking about, we won't tell anyone.
amourAmiH.modeHommeDesc: The questions will be about him.
amourAmiH.modeFemmeDesc: The questions will be about her.
